Birth Record.title: Birth Record
Birth Record.description: This eService allows citizens to apply for a birth record certificate. The application is processed by local Government authorities at the sector level where the applicant is registered.

Birth Certificate.title: Birth Certificate
Birth Certificate.description: This eService allows citizens to apply for an official birth certificate. The application is processed by local Government authorities at the sector level where the birth was registered.

Certificate of Being Single.title: Certificate of Being Single
Certificate of Being Single.description: This eService allows citizens to apply for a certificate of being single. This document confirms that the applicant is not currently married.

Marriage Declaration.title: Marriage Declaration
Marriage Declaration.description: This eService allows couples to submit a marriage declaration before the official ceremony. The application is processed by local Government authorities.

Marriage Certificate.title: Marriage Certificate
Marriage Certificate.description: This eService allows citizens to apply for an official marriage certificate. The application is processed by local Government authorities at the sector level where the marriage was registered.

Death Record.title: Death Record
Death Record.description: This eService allows authorized persons to obtain a death record document. The application is processed by local Government authorities at the sector level.

Death Certificate.title: Death Certificate
Death Certificate.description: This eService allows family members or authorized persons to apply for an official death certificate. The application is processed by local Government authorities.

Divorce Record.title: Divorce Record
Divorce Record.description: This eService allows citizens to obtain a divorce record document. The application is processed by local Government authorities at the sector level.

Divorce Certificate.title: Divorce Certificate
Divorce Certificate.description: This eService allows citizens to apply for an official certificate of divorce. The application is processed by local Government authorities.

Adoption Record.title: Adoption Record
Adoption Record.description: This eService allows authorized persons to access adoption records. The application is processed by relevant Government authorities with strict confidentiality.

Adoption Certificate.title: Adoption Certificate
Adoption Certificate.description: This eService allows adoptive parents to apply for an official adoption certificate. The application is processed by relevant Government authorities.

Resident ID Card First Application.title: Resident ID Card First Application
Resident ID Card First Application.description: This eService allows citizens aged 16 and above to apply for their first resident identification card.

Replacement of Resident ID Card.title: Replacement of Resident ID Card
Replacement of Resident ID Card.description: This eService allows citizens to apply for a replacement of their lost, stolen, or damaged resident ID card.

Renewal of Resident ID Card.title: Renewal of Resident ID Card
Renewal of Resident ID Card.description: This eService allows citizens to renew their expired resident identification card.

Criminal Record Certificate.title: Criminal Record Certificate
Criminal Record Certificate.description: This eService allows citizens to apply for a criminal record certificate, which shows whether the applicant has any criminal convictions.

Updated Criminal Record Certificate (Per.title: Updated Criminal Record Certificate (Personal Information Update etc)
Updated Criminal Record Certificate (Per.description: This eService allows applicants to request corrections or updates to errors in their criminal record certificate details.

Educational Activity License.title: Educational Activity License
Educational Activity License.description: This eService allows institutions to apply for a license to operate educational activities and programs.

Hospital License.title: Hospital License
Hospital License.description: This eService allows healthcare institutions to apply for a license to operate a hospital.

Gambling License.title: Gambling License
Gambling License.description: This eService allows businesses to apply for a license to operate gambling services.

Startup License.title: Startup License
Startup License.description: This eService allows entrepreneurs to apply for a specialized license for startup businesses.

Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Ap.title: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Approval
Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Ap.description: This eService allows businesses to apply for environmental impact assessment approval for projects.

Waste Management & Disposal Permit.title: Waste Management & Disposal Permit
Waste Management & Disposal Permit.description: This eService allows businesses to apply for a permit to manage and dispose of waste materials.

Pollution Emission Permit.title: Pollution Emission Permit
Pollution Emission Permit.description: This eService allows industrial facilities to apply for a permit to emit controlled substances.

Building Construction Permit.title: Building Construction Permit
Building Construction Permit.description: This eService allows property owners to apply for a permit to construct new buildings.

Demolition Permit.title: Demolition Permit
Demolition Permit.description: This eService allows property owners to apply for a permit to demolish structures.

Occupancy Certificate (Post-Construction.title: Occupancy Certificate (Post-Construction Approval)
Occupancy Certificate (Post-Construction.description: This eService allows property owners to apply for an occupancy certificate after construction.

Renovation/Modification Authorization.title: Renovation/Modification Authorization
Renovation/Modification Authorization.description: This eService allows property owners to apply for authorization to renovate or modify buildings.

Local Business Registration.title: Local Business Registration
Local Business Registration.description: This eService allows local entrepreneurs to register their business.

Foreign Business Registration.title: Foreign Business Registration
Foreign Business Registration.description: This eService allows foreign investors to register their business.

Import/Export License.title: Import/Export License
Import/Export License.description: This eService allows businesses to apply for a license to import or export goods.

Wholesale/Retail Trade License.title: Wholesale/Retail Trade License
Wholesale/Retail Trade License.description: This eService allows businesses to apply for a wholesale or retail trade license.

Professional Service License.title: Professional Service License
Professional Service License.description: This eService allows professionals to apply for a license to provide professional services.

Industrial Production License.title: Industrial Production License
Industrial Production License.description: This eService allows businesses to apply for a license for industrial production activities.
